clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather's death in July 1989, within the following months: your mother's worry over money in March 1988 and her move to distance from your father over money in May 1988, your brother's grades falling in November 1989, and your mother calmer once back at work by March 1990. The shifts pile up across the loss and settle within a year of it.

clusters.name: Your mother Della told she had breast cancer, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Within months of your mother's diagnosis in February 1995: your migraines keeping you in bed from March 1994 as you were away at college from September 1993, your calls to your brother most nights from April 1994, your stop returning his calls by June 1995, and your distance from your mother by February 1996. Every shift in these months is yours, and no one else's shows then.
